invariants.rationale: After incrementing, index is either exactly one less than states.size (if we removed the last element) or equal to states.size.
index is incremented and typically represents a position or count, thus should not be negative if used as array/list index.
The size of a collection is always non-negative.
If states has elements, index is always less than its size (before possible removal), preserving non-out-of-bounds access.
